_note: Rounded public figures for each class, not the spec sheet of one airframe. m, kg, s, m/s, deg. multirotor: max_tilt_deg sets drag, it reaches max_speed_mps at full tilt. fixed_wing: turns by banking (radius = v^2 / (g tan bank)) and holds airspeed. rcs_dbsm is a rough nose-on X-band radar cross-section for the class (RCS varies a lot with aspect angle; this is not a measurement of one airframe). thermal_dt_k: how much warmer than the background the drone looks to a thermal camera, averaged over its outline. spl_1m_db: sound level 1 m from the drone. Both are rough class figures.

quadcopter.name: Camera quadcopter (DJI Mavic 3 class)
quadcopter.note: arms unfolded, without propellers; max speed is sport mode (normal 15 m/s); spec endurance 46 min, ~40 in cold weather

fixed_wing_recon.name: Fixed-wing recon drone (Orlan-10 class)
fixed_wing_recon.note: claimed endurance up to 16 h; 10 h is a safer figure

delta_wing.name: One-way attack drone (Shahed-136 / Geran-2 class)
delta_wing.note: range ~2,000 km at cruise speed; composite airframe with a small piston engine keeps the RCS low for its size

decoy.name: Decoy drone (Gerbera class)
decoy.note: size, mass and speed are rough: public reports vary and the type keeps changing
